title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Standard and Basic licensed devices in the Pro Management portal
summary: Hold: the statement that Microsoft has not described what happens without administrator action is too broad. Microsoft documents automatic device enrollment and appearance in the portal; the remaining uncertainty should be limited to licence enforcement. The licence-assignment path and Graph operation are supported.
